news.contents: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy was written off in Minnesota and traded for a measly 2027 fifth-round pick. That trade looks like a bargain. Since joining the Giants, he's thrown for 495 yards on just 49 throws, an absurd 10.1 yards per attempt. He threw for 243 yards in late relief against New Orleans in Week 6 and 252 yards against Houston in Week 7. So far, his stats have been excellent, and his game tape may be even more impressive. news.contents: Denver Broncos wide receiver Courtland Sutton has disappointed all season, and Week 7 in Arizona was no exception. Sutton finished with just three receptions for 45 yards, bringing his season totals to 16 receptions for 168 yards and one touchdown. That's a good afternoon for Jaxon Smith-Njigba; that's a whole season for Sutton. The Broncos' passing game has struggled all year (to put it politely). news.title: Courtland Sutton Remains Difficult to Roster

news.analysis: Boutte recorded a season-low offensive snap rate in Week 7: 31%. This is notable given Xavier Hutchinson's involvement and Marvin Harrison's expected role growth. Jaylin Noel did suffer an injury, but Boutte has yet to surpass 40 receiving yards in a game and has seen a decrease in snap rate in each of the last two weeks.
